rule: public facts only (receipt hashes, counts, pass flags); prices and returns stay sealed for the owner (results-public-key.pem)

timing.signal: intraday on the bar whose high reaches the trigger (stop order resting from the prior close)
timing.earliestExecutable: same bar: fill = max(open, trigger); every level uses only bars up to the prior close
timing.decisionData: prior-close N, prior-close channels, prior-close strength rank

conventions: liquidity: no participation limit in the source ("liquid markets" = research universe protocol); every run reports fill participation of bar volume and of the 20-session mean as a diagnostic

daily bars: the order of intrabar events is a convention: on a held bar exits come before adds and a raised stop is re-checked pessimistically; on the entry bar the order is entry -> adds -> unit stops above the channel level -> channel exit, even if the low was traded at the open (pessimistic, counted)
model assumptions are reported, never decided by result: MA-TUR-INTRABAR-ORDER (scenario ENTRY_BAR_OPTIMISTIC), MA-TUR-HELD-BAR-ORDER (fixed convention, no bound)

modelAssumptions.question: On a bar that reaches an entry or add level AND a stop or exit level, which came first?
modelAssumptions.source: not decidable: the source trades intraday (TUR-INTRADAY, TUR-ADDFAST); daily OHLC bars do not record the order

reference.meaning: the low comes after the entry and the adds (unit stops and channel level checked after them; the S1 filter resolves its hypothetical breakout on the breakout bar the same way)

alternative.meaning: the low comes before the entry: no same-bar stop or channel exit after an entry or add

modelAssumptions.resolvableWith: intraday bars of the trigger days (IEX minutes from 2017 exist privately for the r9 study; not frozen in the snapshot)

modelAssumptions.question: On a held bar with several levels in range, which is reached first?

reference.meaning: the level nearer the open first (unit stops above the channel level before it); exits before adds; no add on a bar on which a unit was stopped

modelAssumptions.question: Does a still unresolved (open) hypothetical last breakout make System 1 skip the next 20-day breakout?
modelAssumptions.source: TUR-S1SKIP defines a skip after a winning last breakout; the source does not say how an open one counts (#709 VU-TUR lists "open breakout assumed a winner" as a VU formalization)

reference.meaning: an open breakout counts as not losing: skip (the 55-day failsafe can still enter)

alternative.meaning: only a resolved winning breakout skips; an open one does not

modelAssumptions.question: Which exit does a 55-day failsafe position use?
modelAssumptions.source: TUR-FAILSAFE states only the entry; #709 VU-TUR: "Failsafe-Exit10 ist Auslegung, nicht ausdrücklich veröffentlichte Failsafe-Regel"; #709 revalidation TUR-F-FAILSAFE-55: "Ausstiegsregel für Failsafe-Positionen nicht ausdrücklich genannt"; #712 spec V4 T4-FAILSAFE: "exit like S1 (interpretation)"

reference.meaning: System 1 exit (10-day low); the reading of the earlier VU engines, an interpretation

alternative.meaning: System 2 exit (20-day low), the exit of the system whose entry channel the failsafe uses; equally an interpretation

timing.decisionData: box boundaries known at the prior close

timing.earliestExecutable: a reviewer decision after the week closes; never back-filled into history
timing.decisionData: weekly bars up to the signal week, SPY weekly for RS and market evidence

timing.signal: the completed week whose high exceeds the high of the consolidation
timing.earliestExecutable: a reviewer decision after the week closes; never back-filled into history
timing.decisionData: weekly bars up to the signal week

timing.earliestExecutable: a reviewer decision after the close; never back-filled into history
timing.decisionData: daily bars up to the close

timing.signal: the daily close on which the measured run-up and consolidation criteria hold
timing.earliestExecutable: a reviewer decision after the close
timing.decisionData: daily bars up to the close

timing.signal: daily close (screen); the daily breakout entry is the breakout-day close, at which the low of day is final
timing.earliestExecutable: breakout-day close (market-on-close) after the reviewer accepts the level
timing.decisionData: daily bars up to and including the breakout day; the stop check uses that day's final low

conventions: the opening-range-high entry (his main entry) is DATA_BLOCKED; the daily close variant is the written alternative (KK-011), not the same execution
the final low of day is unknown during an intraday entry; the daily variant enters at the close so that the stop rule can be evaluated exactly

timing.signal: daily close of the gap day (full-day volume)
timing.earliestExecutable: reviewer decision after the close; intraday projected volume is not available

conventions: daily variant only: evaluated with full-day volume after the close

conventions: the primary source W-RAS04 discloses neither entry order nor stop (#709 C13); both rest on the secondary source W-RAS97 (D-RAS97), trailing and size stay undisclosed, so no historical method return can be computed
